title.value: Proto-Value Networks: Scaling Representation Learning with Auxiliary Tasks
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the content of the paper, which focuses on the use of proto-value networks and auxiliary tasks for scaling representation learning in reinforcement learning.
title.quote: Proto-Value Networks: Scaling Representation Learning with Auxiliary Tasks

extractions.description: The paper discusses the development of proto-value networks (PVN) which extend proto-value functions to deep reinforcement learning by incorporating auxiliary tasks. The study investigates the effectiveness of using a large number of auxiliary tasks for learning rich representations and the scalability of these tasks with network capacity, demonstrating that rich features can be learned efficiently with random initialization and minimal environment interaction.

new_primary_sub_category.value: Scaling and Efficiency in Representation Learning
new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper specifically deals with the scalability and efficiency of representation learning through the use of auxiliary tasks, leading to the development of proto-value networks.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: This is perhaps surprising given that many auxiliary tasks are defined procedurally, and hence can be treated as an essentially infinite source of information about the environment.
